mapper.insert: insert into sys_user (student_no, password, real_name, phone, id_card, role_id, status) values (#{studentNo}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{phone}, #{idCard}, #{roleId}, #{status})

insert into mh_archive (student_id, student_no, name, archive_status, risk_level, create_time, update_time) values (#{studentId}, #{studentNo}, #{name}, #{archiveStatus}, #{riskLevel}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
